literature_notes: All three ledger lines (L1, L2, L3) describe C-terminal tags on full-length, membrane-anchored CALHM4 (Venus-myc-SBP, myc-His, and His6 fusions). The authoritative topology places the C-terminus (residue 314, P) deep within the intracellular domain (residues 203–314). These constructs are therefore intracellular C-terminal fusions, not extracellular surface tags. No ledger line reports any tag insertion at an extracellular terminus or within either extracellular loop (ECL1: 31–48; ECL2: 125–186). The N-terminus (residues 1–14) is also intracellular. With no ledger evidence grounding an extracellular insertion, zero sites are proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal Venus-myc-SBP and myc-His tags appended after the last residue (P314); the entire C-terminal tail (residues 203–314) is intracellular per topology, so these tags face the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
